question.worked_solution:
First, we clear the rational expression by multiplying the equation through by $6$:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3k-2}{6} & =-(k+2) \\ 6\cdot (\frac{3k-2}{6}) & =6\cdot (-(k+2)) \\ \cancel{6}\cdot (\frac{3k-2}{\cancel{6}}) & =-6(k+2) \\ 3k-2 & =-6k-12\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we solve the remaining equation using the addition and multiplication principles:

$$
\begin{aligned}3k-2 & =-6k-12 \\ 3k-2+6k & =-6k-12+6k \\ 9k-2 & =-12 \\ 9k-2+2 & =-12+2 \\ 9k & =-10 \\ \frac{9k}{9} & =\frac{-10}{9} \\ k & =-\frac{10}{9}\end{aligned}
$$
